title: Editing: Hold Me Tight/Lazy Dynamite/Hands Of Love/Power Cut by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Alan Parsons

The closing medley on Wings’ second album Red Rose Speedway was assembled on 16 January 1973.

Studio engineer Alan Parsons created a crossfade between ‘Hold Me Tight’ and ‘Lazy Dynamite’, and ‘Hands Of Love’ to ‘Power Cut’. The two sections were then edited together.

Page last updated: 27 November 2025
